workflows.content:
name: Build

# INTENTIONALLY INSECURE — extends the critical demo with two controls the
# other workflows don't exercise: archived actions and a weakened security job.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-notes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # Upstream repo is archived (read-only, unmaintained — no more security
      # fixes, and the last maintainer can still push a new SHA over the tag).
      # ISSUE-702 (API).
      - uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # A security scanner neutered with continue-on-error: the job is allowed to
    # fail, so a real finding never blocks the pipeline. ISSUE-410.
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: run scanner
        run: echo "pretend to scan for secrets"

# INTENTIONALLY INSECURE — this workflow exists to trip Plumber controls.
# It has no `name:` (ISSUE-601) and no `concurrency:` (ISSUE-418).
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# Grants every scope to GITHUB_TOKEN. ISSUE-803 (high).
permissions: write-all

env:
  # Streams secrets into job logs at debug verbosity. ISSUE-203 (critical).
  ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG: true
  # Re-enables ::set-env:: / ::add-path:: style command injection. ISSUE-208 (high).
  ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS: "true"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      # Mutable, non-digest tag from the forbidden list. ISSUE-102 (medium) + ISSUE-103 (high).
      image: node:latest
      credentials:
        username: ci-bot
        # Registry password hardcoded in plaintext. ISSUE-704 (critical).
        password: sup3rs3cr3t-do-not-commit
    steps:
      # actions/* is a trusted owner (no ISSUE-701) but credentials persist by
      # default into .git/config. ISSUE-307 (high).
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Third-party action pinned by tag, with a published advisory, from an
      # owner outside the authorized allowlist.
      # ISSUE-701 (high) + ISSUE-703 (critical, API) + ISSUE-713 (high).
      - uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45.0.0

      # Third-party action pinned to a 40-char SHA that does not exist in the
      # upstream repo (a real action, but this commit was never pushed there),
      # from an owner outside the authorized allowlist.
      # ISSUE-707 impostor-commit (critical, API) + ISSUE-713 (high).
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@1c9b1f1aaa2222bbbb3333cccc4444dddd5555ee

      # Unpinned package install. ISSUE-214 (medium).
      - name: install tooling
        run: npm install -g some-build-tool

      # Pipes a remote script straight into a shell. ISSUE-411 (high).
      - name: bootstrap
        run: curl -sSL https://get.example.com/install.sh | bash

      # Untrusted PR title interpolated into the shell. ISSUE-207 (critical).
      - name: greet
        run: echo "Building PR ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"

      # Untrusted input written to $GITHUB_ENV. ISSUE-209 (critical).
      - name: export title
        run: echo "PR_TITLE=${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      # Whole github context serialized into a command. ISSUE-213 (high).
      - name: dump context
        run: echo '${{ toJson(github) }}'

      # Entire secrets context exported as one blob. ISSUE-309 (critical).
      - name: export secrets
        env:
          ALL_SECRETS: ${{ toJson(secrets) }}
        run: echo "$ALL_SECRETS" > /tmp/secrets.json

      # Uploads the entire workspace, including .git. ISSUE-419 (medium).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: everything
          path: .
      - name: Upload SARIF
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2 # Actions must not use ambiguous tag/branch refs. ISSUE-710 (Medium)
        with:
          sarif_file: results.sarif

  auto-approve:
    # github.actor is attacker-spoofable. ISSUE-210 (high).
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "auto-approving"

name: Post-CI

# workflow_run is a "dangerous" trigger: it runs in the base context with secrets
# available, even for runs originating from forks. Combined with a checkout of the
# triggering run's head SHA, this is remote code execution. ISSUE-802 (critical).
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: node ./scripts/post-results.js

name: Plumber

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

# Least-privilege: read the repo, write SARIF to code scanning.
# id-token is for the Plumber Score push (publishes only from the default branch).
permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: getplumber/plumber@f84005b69dc57965d192feedd08b4a20fa6e52cc # v0.4.60
        with:
          # This repo is deliberately dangerous (target grade E). Surface every
          # finding to code scanning and publish the live Plumber Score badge,
          # but don't hard-fail CI on the expected result.
          soft-fail: true
          score-push: true

name: PR Preview

# pull_request_target runs with a read/write token in the BASE repo context,
# but this workflow then checks out the untrusted PR HEAD. ISSUE-804 (critical).
on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Fork-controlled code, executed with elevated context.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build

  deploy:
    # Forwards every secret to an external reusable workflow from an
    # unauthorized owner. ISSUE-302 (high) + ISSUE-713 (high).
    uses: acme/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@main
    secrets: inherit

name: Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

# write-all again. ISSUE-803 (high).
permissions: write-all

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # No `environment:` gate on a job that consumes a publish secret. ISSUE-305 (medium).
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4 # persists credentials. ISSUE-307 (high).
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      # Cache key is not scoped to the ref, so a poisoned cache from an untrusted
      # branch can be restored into the release build. ISSUE-705 (high).
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      # Long-lived NPM_TOKEN instead of OIDC trusted publishing (ISSUE-421, high),
      # and the published artifact is never signed (ISSUE-712, medium).
      - run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
